title: The Original Story of Snow White And The Seven Dwarfs | Stories For Teenagers

transcript.text: Once upon a time, in the middle of a cold snowy winter, a queen sat by her window
sowing.
She accidentally pricked her finger with her needle and drops of bright red blood
fell onto the snow on the window sill.
As she looked at the striking contrast of red on white, she whispered to herself,
I wish I had a child with skin as white as snow, lips as red as blood, and hair as black
as this ebony wood.
Not long after the queen gave birth to a baby girl who looked exactly as she had wished,
her skin was pure white, her lips deep red, and her hair black as night.
That happiness was brief for the queen died soon after.
A year passed, and the king married again.
His new queen was a beautiful woman, but she was also proud and cruel.
She couldn't stand the thought of anyone being more beautiful than her.
She had a magical mirror, and every day she stood in front of it and asked,
always made her happy, until one day when Snow White had grown into a lovely little girl.
By the time she was only 7 years old, she had already become more beautiful than the queen.
One morning when the queen asked the mirror the same question, the mirror answered,
you are fair, O queen, it's true, but Snow White is fairer than you.
The queen was furious, her jealousy turned into hatred.
From that moment on, she couldn't stand the sight of Snow White.
Her anger and envy grew each day, until she could no longer bear it.
Take Snow White into the forest, kill her and bring me her heart as proof that she's dead.
The Huntsman obeyed, and led Snow White deep into the woods.
When he raised his knife to kill her, she began to cry.
Please dear Huntsman, don't hurt me, let me go, and I promise I'll never come back.
The Huntsman looked at her innocent face and felt sorry for her.
She was too kind and too beautiful to kill.
Run child, escape and never return.
To trick the queen, he killed a wild boar instead and took its heart back to the castle, pretending
it was Snow White's.
Leaving Snow White dead, the queen had it cooked and ate it.
Meanwhile, Snow White was alone and terrified in the dark forest.
The trees loomed over her, and every rustle of the leaves made her jump.
She ran for hours, not knowing where she was going.
Finally, as the sun began to set, she came across a strange little house in a clearing.
Inside, she found seven small plates, seven cups and seven little beds.
Hungry and exhausted, she tasted a little from each plate and drunk a little from each cup.
She then tried each one of the seven beds until she found one that felt just right.
Night, seven dwarfs returned from mining in the mountains.
Look, someone has been in our house.
Who's been sitting in my chair?
Who's been drinking from my cup?
Who's eaten from my plate?
Someone's been sleeping in my bed, and she's still there.
Who is she?
She's so beautiful.
Oh, yes, she is such a lovely girl.
They didn't wake her, instead they let her sleep.
The seventh dwarf took turns sleeping with each of the others through the night.
In the morning, Snow White woke up and was startled to see the dwarfs, but they were friendly
and kind.
They asked her name and how she had come to be in their home.
Snow White told them her story, the wicked stepmother, the huntsman who had let her go and
how she had wandered through the woods until she found their house.
If you stay here and keep the house tidy, cook, clean, so, and wash, you can live with us,
we'll protect you.
Thank you.
Snow White agreed, and for a time she lived happily.
Before they left each morning, the dwarfs warned her.
Be careful, don't let anyone in, your stepmother will soon find out you're still alive.
Back at the palace, the queen stood before her magic mirror once more.
Mirror, mirror on the wall, who is the fairest one of all?
You are horror, the mirror replied.
You are fair, oh queen, it's true, but Snow White, beyond the hills, with seven dwarfs,
is fairer still.
The queen was furious.
I will not be thwarted.
Disguising herself as an old peddler woman, the queen traveled over the mountains to the
dwarfs cottage.
Lovely laces for sale, beautiful ribbons, good day madam, what are you selling?
Snow White thinking this harmless, open the door and admire the lace.
Oh how lovely, allow me dearly, such a pretty thing needs to be done.
Just right.
Now you'll never be more beautiful than me.
When the dwarfs returned, they revived her just in time.
Thank you.
That was your stepmother, promise us, don't open the door again.
The next day, the queen asked her mirror again.
I will not be thwarted, Snow White will pay.
Enraged, the queen disguised herself once more, this time as a different old woman.
She made a poisonous comb and travelled again to the dwarfs' home.
Pretty combs for your lovely hair, I must not let anyone in.
No need, just take a look from your window.
Snow White admired the comb, when the woman offered to fix it in her hair, she allowed it.
The moment the comb touched her head, the poison worked and she collapsed again.
When the dwarfs returned and saw her lifeless body, they searched and found the comb.
As soon as they pulled it out, she revived.
You must never, ever open the door to strangers again.
When the queen learnt that Snow White was still alive, she created the most dangerous trick
of all.
A beautiful red and white apple, poisoned only on one side.
Then she dressed as a farmer woman and knocked on the dwarfs' door.
Delicious apples fresh from the orchard.
I can't let anyone in.
That's all right.
Here.
I'll cut this one in half.
You eat the red side, I'll eat the white.
That way you'll see it safe.
As soon as Snow White took a bite, she fell to the ground.
When the dwarfs came home, they couldn't revive her, they tried everything, but nothing worked.
She didn't breathe.
She was gone.
For three days they wept over her, then built a glass coffin, placed her in it on the mountain
and one of them always stood watch.
Mirror, mirror on the wall.
Who is the fairest one of all?
You my queen, are the fairest of all.
One day, a prince rode through the forest and saw the beautiful girl in the glass coffin.
He read the golden letters, Snow White, daughter of a king.
He was so moved by her beauty.
Please let me take her with me.
I'll honor her memory always.
At first, the dwarfs refused, but the prince pleaded with such sincerity that they finally
agreed.
As his servants carried the coffin away, they stumbled on a route.
The jolt caused the peace of Poisoned Apple to pop out of Snow White's throat.
After safe now, come with me to my castle.
Will you be my queen?
Snow White smiled and agreed.
A grand wedding was held, Snow White and the prince were married in splendor.
The wicked queen, still believing Snow White was dead, was invited too, before she left,
she stood before her mirror.
Mirror, mirror on the wall, who is the fairest one of all?
You, my queen, are fair, it's true, but the new queen is fairer than you.
The queen's heart was filled with dread, but she had to see who this new queen was.
At the wedding feast, a punishment had been prepared.
The queen was forced to wear red-hot iron shoes and dance in them until she dropped to the
floor, never to rise again.
And so, Snow White and the prince ruled their kingdom with kindness and joy.
She never forgot the dwarfs who had saved her, and they visited often, always welcomed as
honored guests, and they all lived happily ever after.
